builds.name: Reference: Physical pick
builds.goal: Reference for Talon: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A roaming physical assassin who crosses terrain, stacks ability wounds and uses an attack to trigger the bleed. Trigger three ability wounds with a real attack and record wall-route access. Sustained bruiser spending must justify repeated contact rather than assume every roam yields a kill. Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
builds.summary: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Talon: Trigger three ability wounds with a real attack and record wall-route access. Sustained bruiser spending must justify repeated contact rather than assume every roam yields a kill.

Start with the early core (Youmuu, then Profane Hydra) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Low health and defense; spell shields/proc cooldowns must be reset between tests.

The route fails Talon's stated kit question: Trigger three ability wounds with a real attack and record wall-route access. Sustained bruiser spending must justify repeated contact rather than assume every roam yields a kill.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Low health and defense; spell shields/proc cooldowns must be reset between tests.
Full cost 15,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Youmuu, then Profane Hydra. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge, Guardian Angel are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Talon disperses a ring of blades that deal [90 / 135 / 180 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, gains [(0.4 / 0.55 / 0.7) × 100]% Move Speed, and becomes Invisible for [2.5] seconds. When the Invisibility ends, the blades return to Talon, dealing [90 / 135 / 180 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage again.

If Talon cancels the Invisibility with an Attack or with {{Spell_TalonQ_Name}}, the blades return to the target instead.
Talon vaults over the nearest terrain or structure. Talon cannot dash over the same terrain more than once every [160 / 135 / 110 / 85 / 60] seconds.

Talon's Abilities apply a stack to champions and large jungle monsters they damage for [6] seconds (max 3 stacks).

When Talon Attacks a target with 3 stacks, he deals an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(80 → 280; raw flags preserved) + (2.1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage over [2] seconds.

Talon tosses a volley of blades, dealing [50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. The blades then return to him, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Slowing by [(0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6) × 100]% for [1] second.

Talon leaps to a target and deals [65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. If used in melee range, this Ability instead critically strikes for [(65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1.5 + (1) × Stat(9)[statFormula=2]))] physical damage.

If this Ability kills the target, Talon restores [characterLevelInterpolation(9 → 55; raw flags preserved)] Health and refunds [50]% of its Cooldown.

builds.name: Melee-Q crit boundary
builds.summary: Test the specifically crit-labelled melee Q using one crit-damage item.
builds.goal: Test the specifically crit-labelled melee Q using one crit-damage item.
builds.hypothesis: Q changes from leap damage to a critical hit in melee range, with CriticalDamage retaining Stat(9)[statFormula=2]. Infinity Edge supplies crit damage for a controlled test; AD/lethality and Serylda support the physical sequence. R can bring blades back to an attack/Q target and the final actual attack can trigger three-stack bleed.
testPlan: Required state: Q cast from measured melee range; initial wounds and incoming shields are fixed.
Compare leap versus melee Q with/without Infinity Edge at equal observed AD and armor.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Reaching melee costs health and the crit investment may not affect Q as expected.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The special Q critical formula does not prove crit chance makes ranged Q or bleed crit.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Infinity Edge, Eclipse, Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night, Youmuu's Ghostblade, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Bleed ramp survivor
builds.summary: Use the finite bleed window to test physical shred while preserving a second spell cycle.
builds.goal: Use the finite bleed window to test physical shred while preserving a second spell cycle.
builds.hypothesis: W outbound and return apply physical ability damage and wounds; a real attack at three wounds starts two seconds of 2.1 AD[statFormula=2] bleed. Cleaver can ramp on eligible physical packets; Shojin supports basic spells and Deaths Dance buys a bounded recovery chance if a damaged target dies. E terrain cooldown still limits the exit.
testPlan: Required state: Both W passes and a three-wound attack connect; terrain for E escape is unused.
Record wound application, bleed ticks, Cleaver stacks and time to a second W/Q.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Target escapes before the attack or the bleed kill occurs after Talon dies.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Bleed ticks are not guaranteed separate wound stacks or independently stacking every item effect.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Black Cleaver, Spear of Shojin, Ravenous Hydra, Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
